basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 MTS, Project Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The School of Electrical and Computer Sciences of the Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar (Continuing Education) is filling three posts, one each of Project Manager, Junior Technical Superintendent and Multi-Tasking Staff, on a purely temporary contract in the time-bound research project "Capacity Development Program on Strengthening Capacities in Renewable Energy Technology. Policy, Strategy ,Research Methodology and Pedagogical Skills", sponsored by Deutsche Gesellschaft fur International Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. The consolidated pay is Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 52,000 per month for Project

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Project Manager Not exceeding 40 years Junior Technical Superintendent Not exceeding 35 years Multi-Tasking Staff Not exceeding 35 years | The age is counted on the date of the selection process. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PWD will be given age relaxation as per government rules; the notice does not list the number of years. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Visit the Institute's website, www.iitbbs.ac.in, to complete the registration process.
After entering the website, go to the 'Jobs' tab at the top.
Select the option 'Recruitment for Project Staff'.
Fill up the online application form after completing the registration process.
The notice says there is no need to send a hard copy of the application. The notice names no documents to be attached.
important_instructions: The posts are on a purely temporary contract basis in a time-bound research project. Hard copies of the application are not required. Only shortlisted candidates are intimated by email for the interview. Contact details printed on the notice: Continuing Education (CE), Administrative Building, IIT Bhubaneswar, Argul, Khordha, Odisha, 752050; Tel: +91-0674-713-4482; E-mail: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Capacity Development Program on "Strengthening Capacities in Renewable Energy Technology. Policy, Strategy ,Research Methodology and Pedagogical Skills"
Deutsche Gesellschaft fur International Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, Dag – Hammarskjold-Weg 1-5,65760 Eschborn, Federal Republic of Germany

Project Manager; Junior Technical Superintendent; Multi-Tasking Staff
Consolidated, per month: Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 52,000 (Project Manager); Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 46,000 (Junior Technical Superintendent); Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 (Multi-Tasking Staff)
IIT Bhubaneswar, as well as other venues as required (Project Manager and Junior Technical Superintendent)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 3 posts in total, one for each of the following. The notice prints no category-wise break-up of these posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states that the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. Proficiency in computer applications and office productivity tools is essential. A minimum of 2 years of post-qualification professional experience in academic/R&D institutes, research/administrative or managerial roles within Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs), Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), or similar organizations. Proficiency in computer applications and office productivity tools is essential. Post-qualification professional experience in academic/R&D institutes, administrative or managerial roles within CFTIs, PSUs, or similar organizations is desirable but not mandatory. Working knowledge of MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint). Basic computer proficiency, including internet and email usage. Experience in office administration, record maintenance, data entry, and documentation in research projects/institutions will be preferred. Good communication and organizational skills. The age is counted on the date of the selection process. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PWD will be given age relaxation as per government rules; the notice does not list the number of years. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech/M.Tech or equivalent in disciplines such as Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Power Engineering/Energy Engineering/Electronics & Communication or equivalent, with at least 60% marks or equivalent grade
rows.desirable: Valid GATE score if applying with a B.Tech/BE degree

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech/M.Tech or equivalent in disciplines such as Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Power Engineering/Energy Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent, with at least 60% marks or equivalent grade
rows.desirable: Valid GATE score if applying with a B.Tech/BE degree (preferable); professional experience (desirable, not mandatory)

rows.essential_qualification: Passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from a recognized Board/Institution
rows.desirable: Diploma in Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Power Engineering/Energy Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering (preferable)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emolument is consolidated for all three posts. The appointment to these contractual positions is initially for 12 (Twelve) months. It can be further extended subject to satisfactory performance, availability of funds and requirement in the project. The project itself runs for 18 months starting from August 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one description for both posts: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the project at IIT Bhubaneswar as well as other venues as required, while assisting the Principal Investigator in different activities. Manage administrative processes, maintain project documentation, organise events, and support research and project staff onboarding. Maintain compliance, manage resources and assets, and prepare reports. Facilitate communication between interdisciplinary teams and different Government, Public and private entities. Support the project's objectives, including fostering cutting-edge research and capacity-building activities. Perform any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator (PI) from time to time. Provide administrative and clerical support to the project and maintain project-related documents, files and records. Perform data entry and prepare reports using MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Assist the Principal Investigator in meetings, workshops, training programmes and field activities. Handle official correspondence, photocopying, scanning, printing and filing. Support procurement, inventory management and logistics as per project requirements. Perform any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator (PI) from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Institute's website, www.iitbbs.ac.in , to complete the registration process. After entering the website, go to the 'Jobs' tab at the top. Select the option 'Recruitment for Project Staff'. Fill up the online application form after completing the registration process. Apply on or before 27 November 2026. The notice says there is no need to send a hard copy of the application. The notice names no documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection to the post will be done through a written test or interaction, or both, from among the shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email for the interview. The notice does not give the date, venue or syllabus of the written test or interaction.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The posts are on a purely temporary contract basis in a time-bound research project. Hard copies of the application are not required. Only shortlisted candidates are intimated by email for the interview. Contact details printed on the notice: Continuing Education (CE), Administrative Building, IIT Bhubaneswar, Argul, Khordha, Odisha, 752050; Tel: +91-0674-713-4482; E-mail: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in total: 1 Project Manager, 1 Junior Technical Superintendent and 1 Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhubaneswar project posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 27 November 2026, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Project Manager and Junior Technical Superintendent?
faq.answer: Both posts need B.Tech/M.Tech or equivalent in disciplines such as Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, Power, Energy or Electronics & Communication Engineering, with at least 60% marks or equivalent grade. Project Manager also needs a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification professional experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Multi-Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: Multi-Tasking Staff must have passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from a recognized Board/Institution. A Diploma in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, Power, Energy or Electronics & Communication Engineering is preferable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 40 years for Project Manager and not exceeding 35 years for Junior Technical Superintendent and Multi-Tasking Staff, on the date of the selection process. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get age relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated emolument is Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 52,000 per month for Project Manager, Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 46,000 for Junior Technical Superintendent and Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 for Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register on www.iitbbs.ac.in, open the 'Jobs' tab, select 'Recruitment for Project Staff' and fill up the online application form. No hard copy of the application needs to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test or interaction, or both, from among the shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates are intimated through email for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job and how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary contract. The appointment is initially for 12 months and can be extended subject to satisfactory performance, availability of funds and requirement in the project.
